title: Deep focus mode not working and no way to delete account!
body:
Have used this app for 20+ hours and twice it happened now that all my trees withered because apparently I went away from the app. 

The only thing I did, from a locked phone, go directly into the app and it said “better luck next time”.

I won’t use the app without deep focus mode since that remove the reason for this app. 

If you plan on using this app and need the motivation of your trees withering if you leave the app, don’t pay for this because it doesn’t work all the time. 

Hate working, feeling like I got things done and then check the time left and see the trees withered..

There is also no way to delete your information so if you care about your privacy, don’t create an account and maybe not use the app at all!

title: Great for someone with ADHD
body:
I love it! I think this app worth the money. I have ADHD and I use this at work and at home when I have to clean and do other boring tasks. It gets easier when I just set a timer for however long I need to be doing something. 25 min intervals is generally a good amount of time, so if you use the pomodoro technique you'll get one tree for every 25 minutes when you use this app. I always think it's hard to get started with tasks, and sometimes I usually start this app to make it easier to get in the right mindset, and make myself want to deserve a pretty forrest. So I start it evan if I can't focus at 100% to just have it as an habit. And I do think it helps at least with getting started, and sometimes staying on track as well when you see how little time is left and how much your tree has grown.

I just wish I had more friends who use it so we could follow each other and see each others progress. But using it by myself is also great since I mostly do it to motivate myself. So try this app if you need more motivation to get things done! And if you like it, buy it to support the creators of the app!

body: I normally never write app reviews, but I feel like this one has to shared with the world. I am so much more motivated to study and keep focused with this app. By setting the tree-timer to your preferred focus time, you grow a tree by not touching you phone in that time. If you do, your tree dies. Once you have grown a tree it show up in a little forrest. It is so satisfying seeing a little forest in front of you after a productive day! And killing a tree by flicking with your phone is really helpful to stay away from it.... What motivates me the most is that once you have grown enough focus-trees, you can plant a real tree. This makes me feel like I am studying for the world’s forests 🌱

title: Surprised!
body: The app is simple to use and handle. It has a pleasing and relaxed design that in itself has a stress reducing effect. It’s function follows the ‘Pomodoro’ concept and aim to keep you away from other things and focus on a particular task for a given space of time (that you choose yourself). This it does superbly because it gives you a little reward in form of a virtual planted tree for each uninterrupted time-space. Eventually you will build a lush forest. I am surprised how well this little rewarding-tweak functions... I really want that forest! I am not giving 5 stars since I would want the app to provide for an info badge (of time progress etc.) when the phone is in lock-mode, so till then it’s four stars. Nevertheless, to all of you in search of help to better do concentrated work... give this a try.
